name: ML-PREPARE-ABLATION-1
question: How much of the ML-PREPARE-TRAIN-1 gain of Policy v2 comes from the prepare_card input column, as opposed to the 283 extra training decisions?
hypothesis: With identical decisions, menus, labels, seeds, architecture and budget, forcing the prepare_card column to 0 in training, epoch selection and evaluation lowers imitation quality on Prepare-menu decisions relative to prepare_v2.
selection: minimum validation cross-entropy over validation rows with the feature masked (same rule as prepare_v2)

verdict_rules.comparison: prepare_v2 minus ablated_v2, seed-averaged paired differences, validation + test_seen pooled (26 matches), 95% interval from 2000 match-level bootstrap draws (seed 20261015)
verdict_rules.FEATURE_USEFUL: cross-entropy difference on Prepare-menu decisions < 0 with 95% upper bound < 0; negative in validation and in test_seen separately and in at least 2 of 3 seeds in each; and the no-Prepare-menu difference has mean <= +0.03 and upper bound <= +0.05
verdict_rules.FEATURE_WEAK_OR_REDUNDANT: the whole 95% interval of the Prepare-menu cross-entropy difference lies inside [-0.10, +0.10] (the feature cannot account for more than a small part of the -0.37 gain), or its lower bound is > 0
verdict_rules.caveat: Zeroing one column does not remove every cue for the action type (type one-hot, hand_index, absent target and position features remain). A positive result is not evidence of playing strength.

no_training_probe: existing prepare_v2 checkpoints scored with the column zeroed at inference only; reported separately from the retraining comparison
card_identity_probe: inference with the JAIL_913 card id mapped to the unknown-card embedding (stats, text-derived metadata unchanged), for prepare_v2 and ablated_v2
